_comment: Local media catalog. `intensity` is 1 to 3, where 1 is the gentlest and safest to put on when someone is in a bad state, and 3 asks the most of the viewer. Anything that touches assault, abuse or trauma directly is intensity 3 and carries a contentNote, which the card always shows. src/lib/recommend.js scores these against the user's mood and the acuity of the resources they just viewed, and builds the where-to-find-it link from the title and type.

_tagKey.ensemble: Large friendly cast, no single person carries the story.
_tagKey.warmth: Kind. People are good to each other.
_tagKey.women-winning: A woman is competent and wins.
_tagKey.low-stakes: Very little can go wrong in the plot.

media.title: Parks and Recreation
media.description: A small town parks department full of people who genuinely like each other. Episodes are short and the worst outcome is usually a bad meeting.

media.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
media.description: Workplace comedy with a big cast and a joke every few seconds. Fast enough to be hard to think over.

media.title: The Good Place
media.description: Four strangers try to become better people. Silly on the surface, and quietly about whether anyone is beyond repair.

media.title: Abbott Elementary
media.description: Teachers at an underfunded school keep showing up for each other. Warm, funny, twenty minutes an episode.

media.title: Community
media.description: A study group at a community college. Dense, fast, and strange enough to take up your whole attention.

media.title: Schitt's Creek
media.description: A family loses everything and slowly becomes kinder. Nobody in this town is cruel for long.

media.title: Ted Lasso
media.description: A relentlessly decent coach in a job he is not qualified for. About being gentle with people on purpose.

media.title: Taskmaster
media.description: Comedians complete pointless tasks badly. Nothing is at stake, ever, and you can start at any episode.

media.title: Derry Girls
media.description: Teenage girls being loud and ridiculous in 1990s Northern Ireland. Short episodes, very fast jokes.

media.title: New Girl
media.description: Roommates who are bad at being adults. Easy to have on with half your attention.

media.title: Gilmore Girls
media.description: A mother and daughter talk very fast in a small town where almost nothing bad happens.

media.title: Jane the Virgin
media.description: A telenovela send up with a huge heart. Three generations of women who are firmly on each other's side.

media.title: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
media.description: A 1950s housewife discovers she is a very good stand up comic and refuses to stop.

media.title: Queer Eye
media.description: Five people spend a week being unreasonably kind to a stranger. Expect to cry, in the good way.

media.title: The Great British Bake Off
media.description: Amateur bakers in a tent being polite to each other. The worst thing that happens is a collapsed cake.

media.title: The Great Pottery Throw Down
media.description: Same shape as Bake Off, but clay. Slow hands, quiet rooms, people being encouraging.

media.title: Old Enough!
media.description: Small children run their first errand alone. Episodes are about ten minutes and nothing bad happens.

media.title: Somebody Somewhere
media.description: A woman in her forties finds an unlikely group of friends in her hometown. Quiet, funny, and about being seen.

media.title: Our Flag Means Death
media.description: A soft aristocrat decides to become a pirate. An ensemble of misfits who become a family.

media.title: Paddington 2
media.description: A bear tries to buy his aunt a birthday present. Sincerely one of the kindest films made.

media.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
media.description: A young witch moves to a new town and starts a delivery business. Mostly about being tired and finding your feet again.

media.title: My Neighbor Totoro
media.description: Two sisters in the countryside meet a forest spirit. Almost no plot. Extremely safe to fall asleep to.

media.title: Moana
media.description: A girl takes a boat past the reef because nobody else will. Good songs, and she is right the whole time.

media.title: Encanto
media.description: A family with magic, and the one girl without any. About being loved without having to be useful.

media.title: Ladies First
media.description: Documentary about Deepika Kumari, who went from a village in India to being the world's top ranked archer. She was told no at every stage and kept shooting.

media.title: Legally Blonde
media.description: Everyone underestimates Elle Woods and every one of them is wrong. She wins the case on her own terms.

media.title: Hidden Figures
media.description: Three mathematicians are essential to the space program and have to fight to be allowed to do the work.

media.title: Ocean's Eight
media.description: A crew of women plan a heist and execute it perfectly. Competence from start to finish, and they get away with it.

media.title: Erin Brockovich
media.description: A woman with no legal training takes on a utility company poisoning a town, and wins. Satisfying, but it does not go easy on you.

media.title: A League of Their Own
media.description: A women's baseball league in the 1940s. Being good at something in public, with a team behind you.

media.title: Bend It Like Beckham
media.description: A teenager plays football against her family's wishes and is very good at it. Ends well for her.

media.title: Enola Holmes
media.description: Sherlock's younger sister solves the case herself and is extremely pleased about it.

media.title: The Princess Diaries
media.description: An awkward teenager finds out she is royalty. Nothing bad happens to her and everyone comes around.

media.title: Sister Act
media.description: A lounge singer hides in a convent and accidentally builds the best choir in the city.

media.title: Mamma Mia!
media.description: ABBA songs, a Greek island, and women who have been friends for thirty years. Turn your brain off entirely.

media.title: Crazy Rich Asians
media.description: A woman meets her boyfriend's impossible family and refuses to shrink for them.

media.title: Booksmart
media.description: Two best friends try to have one good night before graduation. Mostly about the friendship.

media.title: Little Women
media.description: Four sisters, and one of them refuses to let anyone else decide what her life is for.

media.title: Julie & Julia
media.description: Two women, decades apart, cook their way out of feeling stuck. Very little conflict, a lot of butter.

media.title: Ologies
media.description: A friendly interview with a different scientist each week. Something to put in your ears that is interesting but asks nothing of you.

media.title: Beyoncé - Renaissance
media.description: A dance record built to be played loud. Made for moving around your room rather than sitting still.

media.title: Lizzo - Special
media.description: Relentlessly on your side. Hard to keep a bad posture through it.

media.title: Olivia Rodrigo - GUTS
media.description: Loud, furious, and funny about it. For when you want the anger matched rather than soothed.

media.title: Chappell Roan - The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess
media.description: Big theatrical pop about deciding you are the main character. Best played at volume.

media.title: Megan Thee Stallion - Good News
media.description: Pure confidence on a loop. The getting ready record.

media.title: Taylor Swift - 1989
media.description: Bright, familiar pop you already know the words to. Easy company.

media.title: Kacey Musgraves - Golden Hour
media.description: Warm and slow without being sad. Good for a quiet evening that you want to stay quiet.

media.title: Norah Jones - Come Away With Me
media.description: Soft piano and a low voice. Safe to fall asleep to.

media.title: Sade - Love Deluxe
media.description: Calm, smooth, and completely unhurried. Nothing on it will startle you.

media.title: Lo-fi Beats to Relax To
media.description: Instrumental, no lyrics, no surprises. For when words are too much but silence is worse.

media.title: Beach Read - Emily Henry
media.description: Two writers, one summer, a slow burn romance. Funny and low stakes throughout.

media.title: The Hating Game - Sally Thorne
media.description: Enemies to lovers in an office. Fast, funny, and it ends exactly how you want it to.

media.title: Red, White & Royal Blue - Casey McQuiston
media.description: A rom com with actual jokes and a very soft heart. Escapist in the best way.

media.title: The House in the Cerulean Sea - TJ Klune
media.description: A caseworker is sent to an orphanage of unusual children. Kind on every single page.

media.title: Anne of Green Gables - L. M. Montgomery
media.description: An orphan talks her way into a family. Comfort reading with no teeth in it.

media.title: Eleanor Oliphant Is Completely Fine - Gail Honeyman
media.description: A lonely woman is slowly pulled back into the world by an ordinary friendship.
media.contentNote: Touches on childhood abuse and a suicide attempt, without graphic detail.

media.title: Braiding Sweetgrass - Robin Wall Kimmerer
media.description: Essays on plants, science and gratitude. Can be read a few pages at a time with nothing lost.

media.title: Untamed - Glennon Doyle
media.description: Short chapters about stopping being who you were told to be. Easy to dip into anywhere.

media.title: Yes Please - Amy Poehler
media.description: Funny essays from someone who likes her friends a lot. No narrative to keep track of.

media.title: Know My Name - Chanel Miller
media.description: The author reclaims her own story from a court case that tried to reduce her to a footnote. Widely described by survivors as the book that made them feel real.
media.contentNote: Describes a sexual assault and the trial that followed in detail. Many people find it steadying, but not early on.

media.title: What My Bones Know - Stephanie Foo
media.description: A journalist researches her own complex PTSD and what actually helped.
media.contentNote: Detailed accounts of childhood abuse and of trauma symptoms.
